entities.summary: Darrell Henderson Jr. is an American professional football running back for the Saskatchewan Roughriders in the Canadian Football League (CFL). He played college football for the Memphis Tigers, and was selected by the Los Angeles Rams in the third round of the 2019 NFL draft.
